'''Dayla Kev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] mission commander with the [[Galactic Scout Corps]] in c. [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]]. She was believed to have been killed by a [[gasnit]] on an uncharted jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]], when a member of her team, [[Milac Troper]] returned with that report. The report stated that Kev and her [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Hereven]], were killed, as Troper had fled, leaving them to [[Death/Legends|die]]. Hereven had tried to rescue Kev and both [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] ended up hiding for more than six months in the caverns located beneath the planet's surface.

During their confinement, the close quarters led to Kev and Hereven falling in love. However, Hereven was killed during a hunting mission. Later, Dayla discovered that she was pregnant with Hereven's child. After giving birth to the boy, Dayla named him "[[Hereven Kev|Hereven]]," in honor of his father. They lived together in hiding for fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]], where they discovered that they had a connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

The two were eventually rescued by a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] explorers, who tried to sell them into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Through using subtle manipulations of the Force, Dayla was able to convince the Wookiees to let them go free. She also convinced the Wookiees to join her in forming a safari-hosting business on the planet. She changed her name to "Lady Ahrkan", and made a small fortune in the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

Kev never forgot Milac Troper, or forgave him for leaving her. Eventually, though, she met up with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roogak]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|herdship]] ''[[Galactic Horizon]]''. She earned his trust, though it cost her almost everything she had. However, her desire to maintain the relationship paid off when her son, Hereven, discovered that Troper was going to be aboard the ''Galactic Horizon'' to negotiate a peace treaty. Kev called in favors owed to her by Captain Roogak and arranged to have several gasnits placed aboard the herdship's ecosystem. Her plans to exact revenge on Troper were thwarted when she encountered the team of freelance mercenaries Troper had hired to protect himself. Kev and Hereven were thus arrested.
